linkedin.about: I turn messy data into useful dashboards for retail clients. I am organised, evidence-minded and I plan ahead, but I laugh when plans fall apart. I run three mornings a week and I listen to a lot of podcasts about statistics and money. Looking for someone who plans ahead and still enjoys a surprise.
